consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Group events by changeset_id before validation. In the app, validate only the target changeset's existing rows plus the candidate, then write the global log after the per-changeset check passes. In the gate, iterate all changeset groups and report the failing…

consensus_points.headline: The dev protection record sets required_approving_reviews to 0 and comments out the oya-pr-review required check. The agentic VCS pipeline can therefore admit security-sensitive changes without an enforced reviewer-agent gate.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Restore a required review gate before treating the pipeline as end-to-end: require either approving reviews or an oya-pr-review check that fails closed when the multispectrum panel is incomplete or pending.

consensus_points.headline: Both promotion workflows document that canary/full-rollout observability gates are FUTURE and currently always promote. This is fail-open promotion from dev to staging and staging to production.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Add mandatory canary and full-rollout health gates before advancing refs, or disable automatic promotion until those gates exist and fail closed on missing/unknown observability evidence.

consensus_points.headline: Both promotion workflows explicitly document their canary/full-rollout gates as future work and currently fast-forward unconditionally. That can promote a bad dev/staging commit without SLO, error-rate, rollback, or incident signal checks.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Gate each fast-forward on a canary controller verdict or equivalent check-run API result, and fail closed with rollback/escalation evidence when the verdict is not PROMOTE.

consensus_points.headline: PR #5 is described as the Foundry pipeline (M-CC-P11) design contract, but the ADRs remain `status: Proposed`. Proposed ADRs do not lock the product/roadmap contract that later PRs are expected to implement.
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Promote ADR-0110..0114 to Accepted only after council signoff, or change PR #5/P11 wording to say it is a proposal and block implementation PRs from treating it as canonical until accepted.

consensus_points.headline: P11 exists as `.omc` phase files, but the current machine-readable masterplan live index does not include M-CC-P11. The canonical agentic VCS substrate cannot be reliably adopted if its phase is only discoverable by filesystem search rather than the masterpla…
consensus_points.recommended_remediation: Regenerate the masterplan live hierarchy with M-CC-P11 and make the plan-hierarchy lane fail when a phase file is absent from `/specs/cross-cutting/masterplan.json`.
